name: NWF Championship
epitaph: The fed's own top title, contested by its own written rules (top-5 ranked contenders only); no card reaches Usenet, so no reign, holder or title match survives in this collection's holdings.

name: NWF Television Championship
epitaph: Defended at every TV taping per the fed's own rules; no holder survives in this collection's holdings.

name: NWF Tag Team Championships
epitaph: Governed by the same top-5-ranking rule as the NWF Championship; no holder survives in this collection's holdings.

name: NWF International Championship
epitaph: Explicitly modelled by the fed's own rules on Lou Thesz and Buddy Rogers' two-out-of-three-falls championship matches, and designed to feud with the NWF Championship; no holder survives in this collection's holdings.
